reviews.text: Excellent service, excellent place, ideal for our furry children...

Unprofessional and Disappointing Experience

If I could give zero stars, I would.

I cannot recommend this grooming place. We really wanted to give them the benefit of the doubt, but after multiple issues, we will not be returning.

The main concern is that our dog has been hurt twice now during a sanitary cut. The first time, we accepted it as an isolated accident and gave them a second chance. But having it happen a second time shows a serious lack of care and proper technique.

Communication and customer service were equally frustrating.

Today, we received a call stating our dog was ready, but when we arrived, staff insisted no such call had been made. It wasn't until I showed them the incoming number on my call log—which they verified was theirs, yet there was still no real accountability or apology offered.

Our dog was noticeably shaken when we picked her up, and upon checking her at home, we found she had been nicked again.

Mistakes can happen, but a simple apology and a bit of honesty would have made a world of difference.

Unfortunately, the repeated carelessness left us deeply disappointed

*** this one of those cases where a $10.00 discount does make up for the trouble.

And for further clarification- Groomer was notified and shown photos of where my puppy was hurt the last time - but this happening twice is unacceptable. And, yes my puppy had matts, but the area where she was hurt- is exactly the area where she did NOT have them.
I loved how they did my dog, great service, they made her look beautiful! 🥰 …
This place gives superior care of my fur babies!  I cannot say enough about the skills of Addi and Courtney!  They could tech a masterclass in Customer Service!
Thank you so much for your 5 star review, we very much appreciate you and look forward to seeing you again soon!

I called with a laundry list of questions, and the groomer I spoke to answered them all very patiently and kindly. I brought my 12 year old, 76 pound dog in on Thursday and could not be happier. she was stressed and overwhelmed, but all the staff was so kind and gentle with her. when I picked her up about an hour and a half later, she was so shiny and soft, and I could tell she felt good! thank you PetBar staff! Chrissy and I will be back 🥰

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Thank you to the team at petbar Dallas! It was a wonderful grooming experience for our fur baby. The staff was incredibly friendly and professional. Highly recommended!

Received the best service for my Claire Bear from the front of house to her groomer Ms. Sherry! We were able to get an appointment within the same week and I was pleased with the style of her poodle cut. I can also tell that my dog loved it here too as she didn’t poop in their lobby! A huge win!
